parameters.query: SELECT m.id, m.division_id, m.match_no, m.stage, m.group_no, m.round_no, m.label, m.home_entry_id, m.away_entry_id, m.pitch, DATE_FORMAT(m.scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS scheduled_at, m.status, m.toss_winner_entry_id, m.toss_decision, m.event_count, m.live, m.result_text, m.winner_entry_id, m.scorer_user_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, m.scorer_seen_at, NOW()) AS scorer_idle, sc.name AS scorer_name, t.code, t.name AS tname, t.sport, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id) AS is_owner, (t.fixtures_published_at IS NOT NULL) AS published, viewer.id AS viewer_id, d.name AS division, d.format, d.match_rules, (t.organizer_user_id = viewer.id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tournament_scorers sc WHERE sc.tournament_id = t.id AND sc.user_id = viewer.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tournament_officials f JOIN tournament_officials_requests q ON q.tournament_id = f.tournament_id WHERE f.tournament_id = t.id AND f.user_id = viewer.id AND f.role = 'SCORER' AND q.status = 'CONFIRMED')) AS can_score, hm.name AS home_name, hm.short_name AS home_short, hm.logo_key AS home_logo, aw.name AS away_name, aw.short_name AS away_short, aw.logo_key AS away_logo, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('member_id', ep.team_member_id, 'user_id', ep.user_id, 'name', COALESCE(u.name, tm.guest_name), 'jersey_number', ep.jersey_number)) FROM tournament_entry_players ep JOIN team_members tm ON tm.id = ep.team_member_id LEFT JOIN app_users u ON u.id = tm.user_id WHERE ep.entry_id = m.home_entry_id) AS home_squad, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('member_id', ep.team_member_id, 'user_id', ep.user_id, 'name', COALESCE(u.name, tm.guest_name), 'jersey_number', ep.jersey_number)) FROM tournament_entry_players ep JOIN team_members tm ON tm.id = ep.team_member_id LEFT JOIN app_users u ON u.id = tm.user_id WHERE ep.entry_id = m.away_entry_id) AS away_squad, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('entry_id', p.entry_id, 'member_id', p.team_member_id, 'name', p.name, 'captain', p.is_captain, 'keeper', p.is_keeper))  FROM match_players p WHERE p.match_id = m.id) AS lineups, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('seq', ev.seq, 'client_id', ev.client_id, 'type', ev.type, 'data', ev.data)) FROM match_events ev WHERE ev.match_id = m.id) AS events FROM tournament_matches m JOIN tournaments t ON t.id = m.tournament_id JOIN tournament_divisions d ON d.id = m.division_id LEFT JOIN app_users viewer ON viewer.phone = $1 LEFT JOIN app_users sc ON sc.id = m.scorer_user_id LEFT JOIN tournament_entries he ON he.id = m.home_entry_id LEFT JOIN teams hm ON hm.id = he.team_id LEFT JOIN tournament_entries ae ON ae.id = m.away_entry_id LEFT JOIN teams aw ON aw.id = ae.team_id WHERE m.id = $2
